sentences.text:
=
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH
ORAL ORDER 3 21-07-2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence under Sections 420, 467,
468, 471 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The petitioner is alleged to have obtained appointment, as Panchayat Teacher, on the basis of forged and fabricated certificate.

4. It is submitted on behalf of petitioner that petitioner was appointed, as Panchayat Teacher, after investigation of all his educational certificates by the concerned department, but later on, same has been declared as forged and fabricated without proper verification or giving any notice to the petitioner.
Moreover, petitioner has already been terminated from service Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.28148 of 2023(3) dt.21-07-2023 by the order of Panchayat Secretary, Bansghat,
Masuriya, Gopalganj, as contained in Memo No. 14 dated 19.07.2023.
Copy of the said letter is annexed as Annexure R/1 to the supplementary affidavit.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State vehemently opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Akhilendra Kumar Singh vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Considering the fact that petitioner has already been terminated from service, let the above named petitioner, in the event of his arrest/surrender before the court below within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Gopalganj in connection with Baikunthpur P.S. Case No. 09 of 2023, subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) anay/-
